On each generating circle the squared ellipsoidal gauge q obeys the exact identity 1-q(v)=(1/b²-1/a²)(v-p)²>=0. The four strict-t contacts, after normalization, have zero mean and second moment I/3. Every containing ellipsoid m+TB³ obeys tr((TTᵀ)^(-1))/3+||T^(-1)m||²<=1; the three-eigenvalue AM–GM bound forces |det T|>=1, and equality uniquely identifies the unit ball after normalization. Strict convexity and the strict quadratic gap give precisely four contacts for t>0; at t=0 both original generating circles are contact. The actual bundled verify.py passed exact rational and floating checks; finite checks supplement, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The classical oloid and all positive-separation convex hulls of two perpendicular circular disks are natural spatial convex bodies. Determining the unrestricted globally unique Löwner ellipsoid for the entire continuous family is a motivated extremal invariant, not a chosen numerical slice. The surprisingly separation-independent normalized regular-tetrahedron contact structure and the zero-separation contact transition are useful exact structural facts. No paper-sized contribution or general downstream theorem is asserted; the closed classification itself supplies the geometric value.
